title: Manicule YC - Indian Founders AgentRel for AI Discovery
content:
YC P26 mein ek Indian-founded startup hai
jiska naam Manicule hai.
Founders: Naman Bansal from Agra, aur
Shreyans Jain. Base San Francisco.
Unhone $1.3 MILLION seed uthaya, co-led by
Y Combinator aur Broom Ventures.
Product thesis: AGENTREL. Matlab products
ko AI agents discover, recommend, aur use
karwayein.

Stay till the end, kyuki practical
takeaway docs aur agent discovery pe hai.

Source clear.
Grit Daily ne report kiya: teenage
founders, no college degrees, $1.3M seed.
YC company page pe Manicule ka tagline
AgentRel hai - DevRel for agents.
YC Launch post ke hisaab se woh AI-native
technical docs aur DevRel-as-a-service
karte hain.
Customers named in reporting: PromptLayer,
Bright Data, Courier, Supermemory.
YC Launch pe Greptile, Reducto, Mastra,
Agentmail jaise names bhi dikhte hain.

AgentRel kya hai, simple words mein.
Pehle software discovery Google search pe
depend karti thi.
Ab users ChatGPT aur Claude se poochte
hain: best tool for X kya hai.
Agar tumhara product DOCS AGENTS PARSE
nahi kar sakte, tum recommend list se
bahar ho.
Manicule ka claim Grit Daily mein:
traditional marketing agencies se 5X
CAPACITY.
Yeh UNKA claim hai, maine independently
measure nahi kiya.

Ab practical angle, jo tum aaj apply kar sakte ho.
Agar tum product ship karte ho, docs aise
likho jo agents parse kar saken.
Clear headings. Concrete outcomes. Working
code snippets. Honest limitations.
Tool descriptions short aur unambiguous rakho.
FAQ mein woh sawal daalo jo real users AI
se poochte hain.

Weekend test: ChatGPT aur Claude dono se poocho -
"best tool for my use case" - bina brand
name bole.
Phir brand name ke saath poocho.
Jo answer aaye, usko apni public docs se
match karo.
Agar AI galat feature invent kare, docs gap hai.
Agar competitor recommend ho aur tum nahi,
content gap hai.

Mera take simple hai.
AgentRel fancy naam hai, lekin underlying
skill purani hai: clear technical writing
plus distribution.
Difference yeh hai ki ab audience humans
PLUS agents hain.
Agar tum early-stage product chala rahe
ho, pehle docs agent-readable banao.
Phir paid AgentRel studio sochna. Hype mat
becho. Docs becho.

Follow karo, roz ka AI update yahin milega.
